name: Room Refresh
description: Room Refresh adds photo-based furniture and decor previews to Shopify product pages. Explore examples, setup, limitations and plans from $19 USD per month.
heroAlt: A room photograph, a wall-clock product photograph, and an illustrative preview of the clock above the sofa
heroCaption: Existing product example: a room photo + a wall-clock product photo → an AI-generated room preview. The preview is illustrative, not a scale drawing.
setupAlt: Room Refresh demo store in Shopify theme editor showing Preview Button enabled under App embeds and View in your space on the product page
setupCaption: Existing Room Refresh demo-store screenshot: the Preview Button app embed and the product-page button. Labels can vary by app or theme version.
headline: See your products in their room.
intro: Room Refresh is a Shopify app for furniture and home-decor merchants. Shoppers upload a room photo and generate a preview of a product in that space, directly from a product page.
fit: For furniture, lighting, wall art, plants and home accessories where seeing the product in context helps a shopper evaluate its appearance.
limitation: AI-generated previews illustrate appearance and placement. They do not provide measured dimensions, guaranteed scale or a live camera-based AR view. Shoppers should check product measurements before buying.
workflow: Install Room Refresh from the Shopify App Store.
Enable the app embed in your theme and approve a subscription in Shopify.
A shopper opens the product-page preview button and uploads a room photo.
The app uses the selected product image to generate a room preview.

features.title: A room photo, not a 3D model
features.text: Customers start with a photo of their space and the product image on your store. The workflow creates an image preview rather than a navigable 3D scene.

features.title: A button on your product pages
features.text: Activate the app embed in Shopify's theme editor. Configure the button and check the result on the product templates your store uses.

features.title: Usage alongside related orders
features.text: Review preview activity and related orders in the app dashboard. Use these as observed activity, not proof that a preview caused a purchase.
